== Usage ==
{{ItemInfo

A '''Warden Helmet''' requires {{CollectionLink|Zombie Slayer 8|img=t}} to use.

When worn, the '''Warden Helmet''' halves its user's {{Stat|speed}}. For every {{Stat|speed|25}} remaining, the helmet grants an additive {{Stat|damage|+20%}} multiplier, and an additive {{Stat|damage|+1%}} multiplier on top of that. This affects all damage, not just the damage applied to weapons (i.e. [[mcw:Melee_attack|fists]] would be affected). The {{Stat|speed}} cap is applied before halving, meaning the maximum cap with a {{Stat|speed|400}} cap is {{Stat|speed|200}}, which grants a {{Stat|damage|+161%}} multiplier. Items that increase the {{Stat|speed}} cap, such as a {{Item|Black Cat Pet}} or {{Item|Unalloyed Speed}}, can increase the maximum {{Stat|damage}} multiplier.

The maximum possible {{Stat|damage}} multiplier in realistic scenarios is {{Stat|dmg|+241%}} with the following:

* {{Item|Black Cat Pet}} with {{Item|Unalloyed Speed}}
* Being in the [[Catacombs]] with {{Attr|Catacombs Cap X}}

However this is generally worse for damage than using a {{Item|Golden Dragon Pet}}, especially when paired with {{Item|Hephaestus Remedies}}.

While not useful in practice, it is possible to get a {{Green|+261%}} damage multiplier if the player additionally holds a {{Item|Cactus Knife}} while on the {{Zone|Garden}}.

== Trivia ==
* The '''Warden Helmet'''{{'}}s {{AbilityName|Brute Force}} doesn't round strictly to multiples of {{Stat|spd|25}}. A player with {{Stat|spd|176}} will deal more damage than the same player with {{Stat|spd|175}}.
* In the [[Catacombs]], several statues feature helmets with the Warden Helmet's texture.
* The '''Warden Helmet''' was first leaked by former {{Rank|admin}} {{RN|MVP+|Minikloon}} in a Discord message.<ref name="wdi">https://ibb.co/ZWYYBcJ</ref>
** This version had {{Stat|hp|375}} and {{Stat|def|150}}, and increased damage by {{Green|25%}} for every {{Stat|spd|50}} above {{Green|100}}.
** Several of the final helmet in its respective armor set's line are either recolored versions or variations of the '''Warden Helmet''': this includes the {{Item|Crimson Helmet}}, {{Item|Fermento Helmet|text=Fermento}} and {{Item|Helianthus Helmet}}, {{Item|Clover Helmet}}, and {{Item|Helmet of Divan}}, among others.
